comment: Static files are routed EXPLICITLY, before the catch-all.
The catch-all used to be the only rule after /api, so every path
on the site returned the 875 KB homepage with 200 — including
/robots.txt, which meant crawlers were served HTML and the
robots file was never actually delivered in production.
Routes are matched in order, so each real file needs its own
entry ahead of the fallback. Add one here when adding a file to
public/ (sitemap.xml goes back here once the domain is decided).
